content.text:
All four items are fixed and merged in [#391](https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/391) (`aa044bb`). The full validation run passed before the PR, all PR checks passed, and CI on `main` passed ([run](https://github.com/cv/pit/actions/runs/43663160759)). I haven't checked the new display in a live Pi session yet, so the PR says `Refs #390` and this issue stays open.

**What changed:**
- **Pending outcome shown:** when a returned object has a string `outcome` field, the one-line summary now ends with it, for example `Returned 12 fields: outcome, status, conclusion · outcome: "pending"`. The ✓ icon itself is unchanged.
- **Singular wording:** `pr.waitForChecks` now says "1 check is still pending". `ci.waitForRun` had the same problem and now says "after 1 check" and "1 check unused"; I updated the one existing test that expected "1 checks".
- **`npm.run` names the script:** the summary now reads `run check, exit 0`. The name comes from the line npm prints before running a script. npm 10 prints it to stdout as `> name@version script`. The npm 12.2.0 on this runner prints it to stderr as `npm notice run name@version script`. If neither line is there, it shows `run, exit N` as before.
- **Waits use the full time budget:** if you don't pass `attempts`, `pr.waitForChecks` and `ci.waitForRun` keep polling until `timeoutMs` runs out instead of stopping after 12 polls. With `timeoutMs: 285000`, that's 20 polls instead of 12. If you do pass `attempts` (1–120), it still caps the wait. I updated `.pi/functions/README.md` and the function docs.

New regression tests cover all four, including both npm banner forms and the 20-poll budget case.

**Still to do before closing #390:** this Pi session still has the old helpers loaded, which is why my own PR-check wait above still reported `requestedAttempts: 12`. Someone needs to `/reload` Pi and confirm three things:
- a pending wait's collapsed row shows `· outcome: "pending"`;
- an `npm.run` row names its script;
- a wait without `attempts` runs to its full `timeoutMs`.

After that, the issue can be closed.
